Commentary.Commentary: We are back for action. The players are out in the middle. Pathum Nissanka and Niroshan Dickwella are the openers for Sri Lanka. Josh Hazlewood to start with the ball.
...The Run Chase...

The Lankan bowlers were not at their best in this game! They were not good in the field and the bowling was also not that great. The pacers were quite poor. Had it not been for Jeffrey Vandersay and Dunith Wellalage they could have been chasing a lot more. Overall, they were quite under par. Now it is onto their batters, they have a stiff task ahead of them and they will need someone to play a special knock if they are to chase this down. Australia on the other hand, will fancy themselves to defend this.

Glenn Maxwell is up for a chat. He says it is nice to be back in Sri Lanka and play in front of a big crowd. Adds that they lost too many wickets early on but they have done well to end. 290 was not looking early on but Head and Green have done well. tells that they are enjoying their time here, coming after quite a few years.

End of a really good batting performance from the Aussies and we feel, they have got to a score which is well over par on this wicket! They did not get off to the best of starts as they lost Warner early. After that though there were quite a few partnerships. The key about this innings for the Aussies were the number of partnerships they managed to build. Also, there was no big score for a single batter but all contributed well. Have to say it was a combined performance and they'll be happier of the two sides at the moment.

Bye! 12 runs off the over! 33 off the last two! Slower ball, outside off. Head swings and misses. Green is already up and running and makes it with a dive. The keeper misses his shy at his end. So, Australia have done really well to post a huge total. They end on 291/6.
FOUR! 290 up for Australia! A loosener from Chameera! A full toss, outside off. Head dabs it past backward point for a boundary.
A slower ball, full and outside off. Head looks to slog-sweep but misses.
Too full and outside off, driven to covers for a single.
SIX! He has certainly proved me wrong! Full ball, around off. Green lofts it nicely over long off for a biggie.
Fuller, outside off, slower. Green looks to heave but misses. He needs to just rotate the strike here

SIX! 21 runs off the over! This has completely changed the momentum in the Aussies' favour! Fuller again, around off. Head kneels and slog-sweeps it over deep mid-wicket for a biggie. Third off the over and Australia get past the 270 mark with ease.
Tossed up, on middle. Head miscues his heave to deep mid-wicket. Two again.
SIX! Two in a row! This one is in the slot, fuller and Head puts his skates on and hammers it over deep mid-wicket for a biggie.

SIX! A spinner in the penultimate over will always be a dangerous sign! And that too against Travis Head who is well settled! He also brings up his fifty! A knock under pressure! Slows it up, full and outside off. Head skips down and thumps it over long on for a biggie.
Slower one, full and outside off. Green comes down but does not reach to the pitch of the ball clearly, drives it to long off for one.
An arm ball, full and on off. Green looks to drive but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Full ball, outside off, this one is at 116 clicks. Head tries to heave it but misses. A boundary at the start but Chameera did well to end the over.
Short of a length and on middle. Head pulls it aerially and to deep mid-wicket for a brace. No timing on that one.

Dropped! Charith Asalanka puts one down! Chameera rolls his fingers on it and serves a full ball, on off. Green tries to clear long off but fails to power and Asalanka dives forward but fails to catch it. A single.
Full and just outside off, pace-off. Green drives it inside the line and the ball goes over the top of off.
Length and on the pads, pulled to square leg for one.
FOUR! What a start to the over! A boundary and that is hit brilliantly! This is full and outside off. Head gets low and smashes it through covers for a boundary.
Ends his spell with a googly, outside off. Head punches it to deep cover for a single. Jeffrey Vandersay ends with three wickets. A really good spell from him.
Tossed up, outside off. Green sweeps it behind square leg for a single.
Around off, it is hit to deep covers for a single.
Flatter and on off. Head smacks it past the bowler and straight down. Long off comes across and keeps it down to two.
Tossed up, full and on off. Green drives it through covers for a single.
Too full and on middle. Head slog-sweeps it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
That is a really good shot for two! Tossed up on off, Green shows the full face of the bat and hits it wide of the fielder at long off for two.
Leg bye! Head comes down the track, he does not get to the pitch of it. Looks to flick but misses. It hits the pad and rolls on the leg side. A leg bye taken.
On middle, Green sweeps it through square leg for one. Dealing in singles at the moment. Sri Lanka won't mind that.
Tossed up outside off, this is swept through mid-wicket for one.
Shorter and on off, Green pushes it towards cover. The fielder misfields and a single is taken.
On middle, Head works it through mid-wicket for one.
Shorter and outside off, this is hit down to long off for one. Another really good over from Jeffrey Vandersay!
Flatter and on middle, Head plays it back to the bowler.
That is hit really hard! Good fielding! Shorter and outside off, this is slapped through covers. Long off runs to his right, slides and saves two for his side.
Cameron Green walks out to the middle.

OUT! WHAT A CATCH THAT IS! This guy Dunith Wellalage is a real talent! Can bat decently, can bowl really well and now has taken a stunner. Also, a high pressure catch as it was off Maxwell. Jeffrey Vandersay has his third. He has been really good today. Tosses it up, outside off. Maxwell looks to drag it over long on but since it turns away, he ends up miscuing it towards mid-wicket and long on. Dunith Wellalage runs back and takes a really good catch from mid-wicket. This can now make a difference of at least 15 runs to the final total.
Commentary.Howout: c Dunith Wellalage b Jeffrey Vandersay

Commentary.Commentary: Shorter and outside off, Head guides it through point for one.
This is brilliant batting! Picking his spots brilliantly. Shorter and on off, Maxwell goes back and lifts it over cover. The man is at deep point and hence, three taken.
A single to end which means Maxwell reatains strike! Shorter and on off, this is pushed towards point for one.
Short and down the leg side. Glenn Maxwell looks to heave it over the fine leg fence but misses. Not wided as he moved across.

How did he run two there? Brilliant! Just shows how much he wants the strike! Shorter and outside off, this is cut over point. They take one, Maxwell goes for the second. It is a poor throw from the fielder in the deep so an easy two.
Looks to be cheeky but not sure if that is the right shot on this wicket! A slower bumper, not a lot of pace on offer. Maxwell looks to upper cut it but misses.

FOUR! That is outrageous! Brilliant from Maxwell! This is on middle, he shuffles across and whips it over the short fine leg fielder. Brilliant. Had he missed that, he would have been a goner. 10 from the first two balls.
SIX! SMACKED! What a shot that is! Yet again an over starts with a boundary! It is a slower one, fuller, Maxwell waits and then slams it down the ground and over the long on fence.
Out comes the reverse sweep, it is hit hard through point but there is a fielder in the deep so only one.
On middle, Head comes down the track and works it through mid-wicket for one.
Shorter and around off, this is slapped to covers. Head needs to get a move on now.
Slower through the air again around off, Maxwell looks to go over covers again but it goes off the outer half towards deep point for one.
FOUR! That is hit hard! Excellent shot from Maxwell again. He has come out all guns blazing here. Short and around off, this is smashed over cover for a boundary.
Quick run! On middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.

FOUR! Audacious! Excellent from Maxwell! He brings out the reverse sweep, knew it is going to be a slower one around off and that is what it is. He plays the reverse sweep past short third man for a boundary. The last ball spoils the over.
WIDE! This one is way too short. It goes well over the batter's head. Wided.
Yet another short one. Maxwell ducks under it.
Two more! Short and wide outside off, Maxwell cuts, it is not timed that well. The man at sweeper cover runs to his left but does not reach it. Two taken.
Fuller and on middle, Head works it through mid-wicket for one.
This did not go as fine as he would have liked! Shorter and on the body, this is pulled behind square on the leg side for one. He was trying to paddle it over short fine leg.
Good length and on off, Head pushes it to mid off and gets to the other end.
Top edge but safe again! Maxwell look for the reverse sweep but this is tossed up slow and down leg. Maxwell swings, it goes off the top edge towards fine leg for two.

PUT DOWN! Dhananjaya de Silva is the man who put in a great effort but it jus did not stay in! Big moment as that would have been a huge wicket. Will this prove costly now? This is tossed up, slower, Maxwell looks to go over covers but ends up miscuing it over that fielder. He runs back, dives forward, for a second it seemed like he has taken it but it pops out. One taken.
Another dot! Tossed up on off, this is pushed to cover.
Top edge but safe! On middle, a lot slower, extra bounce on this one. Head looks to pull, it goes off the top edge over short fine leg for one.
On middle, Head works it to mid-wicket.
Tossed up on middle, Head looks to sweep, it goes off the inner half to short fine leg.
Glenn Maxwell walks out. Also, Powerplay 3 time! Now, 5 fielders are allowed outside the circle till the last over.

OUT! THREE REDS AND CAREY HAS TO WALK BACK! He falls one short of a half ton. Not sure why he reviewed that one. It seemed one more in hope. Dhananjaya de Silve strikes and he breaks the stand at the right time. The two were getting a move on. This is fired on middle, Carey looks to play the paddle scoop but misses to get hit on the pads, right in front. An appeal and the finger is raised. Carey reviews but in vain. He takes a review along with him. A good knock though from Carey.
FOUR! Dragged wide! Second boundary in the over. On middle, this is dragged wide of the fielder at mid on and into the fence.
Smart batting! Now brings out the paddle sweep, he plays it nice and fine on the leg side. Two taken.
Shorter and outside off, this is pushed to cover.
Really well bowled! Excellent from Dhananjaya de Silva! Slows it up and lands it outside off, slower. Carey swings, this lands and turns away. Carey is beaten.
FOUR! Up and over! Picked his spot brilliantly! Goes down on one knee and sweeps it over the man at square leg for a boundary. Once again, a boundary to begin the over.
On off, tossed up, this is pushed down to long off for one. End of another good over for the Aussies.
Two more! Shorter and on off, this is pushed through covers for two. Good placement.
Swing and a miss! Outside off, Carey once again goes for the reverse sweep, this time he misses to get hit on the pads.
Shorter and around off, Head hits it through point for one.
Flatter and on off, this lands and spins away. Carey looks to push at it, it goes off the inner half on the leg side for one.

FOUR! That seemed more like a switch hit! It is on middle, Carey plays it through covers. The fielder in the deep, runs to his left, dives but in vain. GOod start to the over. Australia have decided to step on the gas now.
FOUR! Finally, Head finds the gap! Shorter again, on middle. Head hangs back and pulls it hard wide of deep square leg for a boundary. The stand crosses the 50-run mark as well.
A slower bumper on off, pulled to deep square leg for a single.
Length and outside off. Carey pulls it flat but straight to mid on. Fails to clear the infield.
Slower one on middle, pulled to deep square leg for a single.
On a length and outside off. Head punches it to covers.
Slower length ball, outside off. Head cuts it straight to point.
Tossed up on off, driven down to long off for a single.
On off, cut to deep point for one.
Almost! Shorter and outside off. Carey cuts it hard but uppishly and to covers where Shanaka leaps and pulls out his right hand but fails to stick it. He almost took there. A single.
Too full and outside off, dragged to mid on.
Fuller again, eased down to long off for a single.
Fuller and outside off. Head fails to drive it away past the bowler.
On middle, length, tucked to mid-wicket.
Slants it full and on the pads. Head tickles it to fine leg for a single.
Short of a length, slower and on leg. Carey drops it to mid-wicket for a single.
On the pads, flicked to deep square leg for a single.
Short and on middle. Carey is hurried as he pulls this behind square on the leg side for a single.
Full and on middle, flicked to mid-wicket.
Shorter and on middle. Carey opens up his body and cuts it to deep point for a single.
On middle. Blocked out.

That is the perfect length! Touch fuller and just outside off, it spins away after pitching. Carey prods and looks to drive but misses. Sri Lanka have taken a review for a caught behind actually. UltraEdge shows nothing on it. Review lost!
Full and outside off. Head drives it to long off for one.
Slower, around off, tapped to point.
Tossed up on off, slanting in, it is pushed to point for a quick single.

Drinks! After losing two wickets in succession, Australia have started to repair things. But there is a whole lot of task left out for them to complete. The spinners are enjoying the drift they are getting and they will like to keep things under control further.
Carey calls for a single and makes it with a dive! This is full and on off, he eases it to mid on and scampers across to the other end. There is a shy at the bowler's end but the player misses.
Full and outside off, driven to sweeper cover for a single.
Hits the hard length, on middle, there is a little bit of extra bounce. Head tries to ramp it away but misses it completely.
Outside off. Head splices his drive to the square of the wicket on the off side and comes back for the second.
A length ball, outside off. Carey drives it firmly to the right of mid off and will only get a single.
Fuller and on off, pushed to mid off.
Straight and on off. Head hangs back and punches it back to Maheesh.
Around off, fuller, knocked to covers.
Nearly chopped on! On a length and outside off, there is turn and bounce. Head looks to cut but gets a bottom edge, past the off stump.
On middle, Head pushes it down to mid on.
Too full and on leg, pushed back to the bowler.
A full ball, slanting on middle. Carey plays it to long on for a single.
Short of a length, outside off. Carey punches it to deep cover for a run.
Pitched up, outside off. Carey drives it to point.
On a length and on middle. Head punches it past the bowler and to mid on who does well to run to his right and half-stop it. A single.
Fuller ball, outside off. Head fails to time his drive well and hits it to mid off.
On the pads, flicked past mid-wicket for a couple.
Fuller ball, outside off. Head drives it straight to the cover fielder.
Angles it on the pads. Head wrists it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
On middle, pushed to covers.
Flatter and on middle. Carey punches it to point for a single.
Outside off, dabbed to short third man.
Shorter now, outside off, moving away. Head taps it through covers for a single.
Flatter, quicker and keeps on coming with the angle. Head looks to work it away on the leg side but misses and gets hit on the pads. An appeal for LBW but nothing given. That was hitting the stumps.
A loopy ball, outside off. Carey drives it to covers.
Fuller and on off. Carey hits it to long on for a brace.
Tossed up on middle. Carey mistimes his sweep on the leg side.
SIX! Much needed for the Aussie! This is full and outside off, slower as well. Carey smashes it straight down the ground for a maximum.
Coming with the arm, around off. Carey punches it to the bowler.
On middle. Blocked out.

Four byes! What a delivery this is! Tossed up, full and around middle, this turns in and bounces as well. Head fails to drive it away and the ball bounces over the leg pole and past the keeper for a boundary.
On middle, Carey reverse sweeps it to point for a single.
This is full and on off, turning in. Carey gets back and looks to flick but might have got an inside edge there. Yes, the replay confirms it.
Slower again, on the pads. Head turns it to deep square leg for one.
Floated, full and on leg. Carey whips it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
A googly, outside off. Carey punches it to a deep point for a brace.
Flighted, full and on middle. Head carves it straight to the man at cover.
This one lands on off and turns away. Head watchfully keeps it out.
Slows it up this time, on middle. Carey nudges it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller and on off. Head pushes it to long off and rotates the strike.
Darted on the pads. Carey tucks it to square leg for one more.
A low full toss on off, it is driven to long off for a single.
On middle, this is defended.
On middle, Head is off the mark as he works it through mid-wicket.
Travis Head comes in.

OUT! TAKEN! That is a brilliant catch! Dhananjaya de Silva dropped one earlier on but has taken a blinder! Jeffrey Vandersay gets another one and this one too has turned a lot. It lands around leg, pitches and turns away. Finch looks to work it on the leg side but it goes off the leading edge to the right of first slip who dives and takes it with one hand. Two quick wickets and both the set batters are out of here. Australia in trouble now.
Commentary.Howout: c Dhananjaya de Silva b Jeffrey Vandersay

Commentary.Commentary: Tossed up nicely and on middle, defended.
The sweep is out, it is hit through square leg for one.
On the pads, this is worked to short fine leg.
On the stumps, kept out.
Fuller and on middle, this is hit down to long on for one.
Fuller and on middle, this is pushed down to long on for one.
On off, blocked.
The reverse sweep is out again, it goes more off the toe-end through covers for one.
Flatter and on off, defended.
On off, defended.
On middle, this is worked to mid-wicket.
The sweep on the first ball and now the reverse sweep through point for one.
On the pads, Carey sweeps but to short fine leg.
Alex Carey walks out to the middle.

OUT! STUMPED! That is a beauty, a beauty of a delivery! Well deserved wicket for Jeffrey Vandersay! He could have had both Finch and Marnus Labuschagne! Still though, he gets the breakthrough for his side and a welcome one as these two were going along really well. This is tossed up on off, it drifts back in, it lands around middle and leg and then spins away. Marnus Labuschagne puts in a big stride forward and looks to go over covers but fails to get to the pitch of the ball. He misses, He drags out his back foot and Niroshan Dickwella does the rest. Can Lanka build on this now?
Commentary.Howout: st Niroshan Dickwella b Jeffrey Vandersay

Commentary.Commentary: Shorter and outside off, this is pushed through covers for one.
Angled into the pads, this is worked through square leg for one.
Another one on middle, Marnus Labuschagne flicks it through mid-wicket and gets to the other end.
Fuller and on middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.
Shorter and outside off, this is slapped through covers for one.
Marnus Labuschagne should have put that away! He made really good use of the feet by stepping down, makes it into a full toss, hits it straight to mid off though.
Was there an inside edge? On middle, ML looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pads. No bat on that but going down leg.
A dot to end but the damage was done earlier on! Short and wide outside off, left alone.
A yorker now on off, this is jammed out to covers.

FOUR! Cut away! Short and wide outside off, Finch cuts it through point and this one races away to the fence. This is not a good over from Chamika Karunaratne, he has not been at his best today. He is almost going at 10 per cover.
Angled into the pads, this is clipped past square leg for one.
WIDE! Way too short, wided.
FOUR! Pulled away. Very well controlled! Shorter and on middle, this is pulled past mid on for a boundary.
Misfield! The last few overs have not been the best for Lanka on the field! Shorter and outside off, it is cut towards point where the fielder lets it through. A single taken.
A dot to end! On the pads, Marnus Labuschagne flicks it to mid-wicket.
Finch now finds the gap in the mid-wicket region and gets to the other end.
Another single as this is nudged through mid-wicket.

Two more and the 50-run stand is up! Important one, when Marsh fell, Australia were in a spot of bother but the two have batted really well but they need to go on. They are set and it is not going to be easy for a new batter. This is on middle, it is worked through mid-wicket for two.
Tossed up on middle, defended.
Dhananjaya de Silva gets away with this one! A full toss, Marnus Labuschagne is probably taken by surprise. He sweeps it through square leg for one.
Five singles off the over then! Short of a length and around off. Labuschagne pulls it down to deep square leg for one more.
Outside off, on a length. Finch strokes it through covers for a single.
Outside off, dabbed to third man for a single.
Fifty for Aaron Finch! His 30th in ODI cricket so far! A skipper's knock so far and he would love to convert into a big one! Short and outside off, pulled to deep mid-wicket for a single.
A length ball, outside off. Finch dabs it straight to backward point.
A length ball on off, nudged to deep square leg for a single.
Flighted on leg, Labuschagne drives it to long off for a single.
Slower and outside off, punched to sweeper cover for a single.
On middle, flicked behind square on the leg side for a couple.
SIX! Welcome boundary! Tossed up, slanting on middle. Finch hits it with the spin as he smashes it towards long on for a biggie.
Fuller and on middle. Kept out.
Tad short and on off, Finch cuts it straight to point.
Shorter and outside off. Labuschagne cuts it but again straight to point. Just two runs off it. The spinners have controlled the pace of the game here.
Drifting on the pads, swept to deep square leg for a single.
Gives flight to this one full and on ff. Finch drives it back to the bowler.
An arm ball, around off. Finch prods and blocks it out.
Fuller and outside off. Finch slaps it straight to point.
Flatter and outside off. Labuschagne works it through covers for a single.
Touch fuller and on off. Labuschagne looks to drive but gets an inside edge to square leg for one. An eventful over from Jeffrey Vandersay!

Dropped! There was a chance! Flatter and on off, spinning away. Finch tries to punch off the back foot but gets an outside edge to the let of first slip where the fielder gets a hand to it but fails to hold on. Should have been taken.
Did that carry? No, was just way from the first slip. Fuller and outside off, turning away. Finch looks to drive but gets an outside edge to the right of first slip and it is well away from him.
A googly but slightly on the shorter side. Finch rocks back and gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Slower, tossed up on off. Defended on the front foot.
Drops it short and on middle, it is pulled to deep square leg for a single.

DRINKS! The game is evenly poised at the moment! A wicket here and the hosts will feel they are on top but a good partnership will turn the tide towards Australia. Also, Australia bat deep so if Sri Lanka do not keep picking wickets, the visitors might just get to a score above par which we feel is anything over 265. The wicket is holding up and the Lankan spinners need to make good use of it. An interesting passage awaits.
This one comes with the arm, fuller and on off. Finch lunges to defend across but misses. The impact was clearly outside off.
Slower again, full and outside off, driven through covers for a single.
An arm ball, very slow and around off. Labuschagne looks to work on the leg side but gets a leading edge and it falls short of the man at point.
This one drifts in, on off, it is cut to point.
Full ball, outside off, pushed through covers for a single.
Tossed up, it angles around off and turns away. Finch looks to defend on the front foot but misses.
Tossed up on off. Finch taps it to point and takes a quick single. Very good running there.
Pushed it quicker and on middle. Blocked out.
Flighted ball on middle, flicked to mid-wicket for one more.
Leg bye! Flatter and angling down. Finch tries to sweep but misses and gets hit on the body. A leg bye as it rolls to square leg.
Full and on middle. Labuschagne tucks it to square leg for a single.

What a ripper from Jeffrey Vandersay! A length ball on middle, it lands and spins away. Marnus Labuschagne is squared up as he looks to defend and the ball whizzes past his outside edge and was very close to the off pole as well.
On middle, defended. Got some good drift there into the batter.
Another one tossed up outside off, Finch leaves it alone. Temtping Finch to go over cover which is never easy on a slow wicket.
Angled into the pads, again, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.
That was in the arc, full and on middle, Finch looks to go downtown but it goes off the inner half through square leg for one.
On off, this is pushed down to long off for one.
Shorter and angling into the body, this is worked through square leg for one.
A single to end as this is pushed through covers.
TWO MORE! Edgy! Tossed up on off, this lands and turns away. Finch looks to defend with soft hands, it goes off the outside edge down towards third man for two.
On middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.
Shorter and turning away, comes slow off the surface again. This is slapped down to long off for one.
Flatter and on middle, defended.
Safe! Jeffrey Vandersay tosses it up well outside off, makes Marnus Labuschagne fetch it. He looks to drive but fails to get on top of the bounce. It goes off the top edge towards cover for one.
On off, defended. A decent over then for the Aussies.

FOUR! Swept and done so brilliantly! Australia will hope that will break the shackles! On the pads, Finch sweeps it nice and fine, rolls his wrists nicely on the ball and it goes down to the fine leg fence.
A single as this is pushed down to long off.
On off, pushed to cover.
Angled into the pads, Finch works it through square leg for one.
Flighted, it is the arm ball, Finch yet again defends outside the line, it goes off the inner half on the leg side.
A dot to end! Decent start by Jeffrey Vandersay! Flatter and on off, this is guided to point.
Nicely played! Tossed up on off, Finch strokes it through covers and gets to the other end.
Tossed up on off, this is pushed down to long off for one.
That inside edge saved Finch! On middle, the googly, Finch looks to defend but it goes off the inner half through square leg for one.
Better! Tosses it above the eye line and lands it on middle, defended.
A full toss, Marnus Labuschagne works it through mid-wicket for one.
Jeffrey Vandersay is into the attack.
A dot to end a successful over for Dunith Wellalage! Flighted ball on off, Finch pushes it to covers.
Marnus Labuschagne is off the mark! Shorter and on off, this is pushed through covers for one.
Leading edge! On the pads, Marnus Labuschagne looks to flick but this turns away and goes off the leading edge to covers.
Marnus Labuschagne is the new man in.

OUT! TAKEN! Dunith Wellalage breaksthrough! He has been so impressive in the few overs he has bowled and it is a well-deserved wicket. Marsh looking to drive on the up which is never a good idea on this wicket. This is tossed up incely, around off, Marsh looks to drive it hard through covers but hits it straight to Mendis in that region. Good catch and an important stand has been broken.
Commentary.Howout: c Kusal Mendis b Dunith Wellalage

Commentary.Commentary: How has that missed the off pole? That was so close! Shorter and angling in, this one was pushed through. Marsh looks to cut but is beaten.
Hit hard but to the fielder! Tossed up on off, Marsh smashes it but to covers.
Powerplay 2! Now, 4 fielders are allowed outside the 30-yard circle till the 40th over.
Another one on middle, kept out. End of the first 10. Australia are 47 for 1.
Fuller and on middle, Finch plays it back to the bowler.
On middle, Finch clips it to mid-wicket.
That is really well bowled! Tosses it up outside off, it lands and turns back in. Finch looks to defend but it goes off the inner half to square leg.
Fuller and on middle, this is hit on the bounce to long on for one.
On middle, Finch clips it to mid-wicket for one.
A really good start by Dunith Wellalage! He is growing with confidence after each game! On off, yet again nice and slow. Defended.
Outside off, slightly shorter. Marsh guides it to point.
Not sure of this ploy of playing on the back foot! Flatter and on off, this one skids through. Marsh looks to push at it but it goes off the inside edge and onto the pads.
Angled into the pads, Finch works it towards fine leg and gets to the other end.
This time flatter and on middle, this one straightens. Finch goes back and blocks.
Good start! Slows it up, lands it outside off. Finch looks to push at it, it goes off the outer half to point.
Marsh happy to play back again! On middle, Marsh stays back and defends. Tidy from Maheesh Theekshana!
Uppish but away from the fielder! On middle, Finch works it down to long on and takes one.
Flightes it up on off, Finch works it to mid-wicket.
On middle, this is pushed down to long on for one.
This time he works it through square leg and takes one.
On middle, Finch works it to mid-wicket.

Lands safe! Once again the slowness off the surface causing problems! Fuller and on off, Marsh looks to loft it over mid off but is through his shot a little early. It clears mid off though and two is taken. A good over for the Aussies.
Short and outside off, comes slow off the surface yet again. Marsh looks to cut but chops it on the off side.

FOUR! Not where he wanted it but surely the result he was looking for! Fuller and on middle, Marsh swings, the ball comes slow off the surface and hence, goes off the inner half through mid-wicket. Races away.
On off, this is guided down to third man for one.

FOUR! Thumped down the ground! It hit the stumps at the other end but still have enough to go to the fence! Fuller and on middle, this is hit hard down the ground, it goes off the stumps at the other end and down to the long on fence.
Fuller and on, Finch drives, it goes upppishly but lands short of point. The fielder dives to his left and stops it well.
Chamika Karunaratne is into the attack.
Tossed up on middle. Finch tucks it in front of his pads and to square leg. A single.
Very full and on middle. Marsh drills it to long on for a single.
A loopy ball on middle, pushed back to the bowler.
Quicker this time, fuller and around middle and leg. Marsh misses his flick and gets hit on the pads.
Touch wide of off, fuller and it is driven to point.
A carrom ball, fuller and on off. Blocked out.
Length and outside off, it is hit to backward point.
FOUR! Too straight and on the pads. Finch flicks it aerially and past mid-wicket for a boundary.
Short of a length, outside off, at 142 kph, it straightens off the deck. Finch tries to push inside the line and gets beaten on the outside edge.
Short again on middle. Finch this time pulls it aerially but again wide of the fielder in the deep and the batters get a brace.
Short in length and around off. Finch pulls it comfortably behind square on the leg side for a couple of runs.
On a length and on off. Finch solidly blocks it.
Tossed up, full and on off, pushed to the bowler.
Slightly full and outside off. Marsh works it to point.
Around off, pushed to covers.
No run! Flatter, quicker and around off. Marsh mistimes his punch back to the bowler.
A full toss on middle and it is pushed to long on for one more. Ohh, no, another Free Hit as Maheesh Theekshana again oversteps.
Shorter and outside off, pulled to deep mid-wicket for a single.
On middle, eased to long on for a single.
Leg bye! A length ball, at 145 clicks, on the pads. Finch misses his tuck and gets hit on the pads. It rolls to square leg for a leg bye.
Length and outside off, tapped to covers.
Leg bye! Full ball, slanting on the pads. Marsh misses his flick and it rolls off the pads to square leg for a leg bye.
Mitchell Marsh is the new man in.

OUT! CAUGHT! The dangerous Warner goes for a low score! Good start for the hosts! Dushmantha Chameera tries a short ball for the first time and it is well targeted around leg, cramping David Warner who looks to pull it. he gets a top edge, high in the air and towards fine leg where Maheesh Theekshana runs foward and holds onto it under the scorching heat.
Commentary.Howout: c Maheesh Theekshana b Dushmantha Chameera

Commentary.Commentary: On a length and on middle and leg. Warner blocks it out.
FOUR! Finds the gap! Overpithed, around off. Warner drives it past mid off. The fielder gives a chase but the outfield is too fast and the ball wins the race. A boundary.
Spin again there but Finch blocks it out well! Tossed up, around off. Finch stays back to defend it.
Slower one, full and on middle. Finch tucks it to leg slip. Collects on the bounce.
Darted on the pads, it is flicked past square leg for a couple of runs.
Dot ball! Very full and on off. Finch smashes it straight back to Maheesh Theekshana who stops it.
No ball! Tossed up, outside off. David drives it to long off for a single. Another no ball, this time Maheesh Theekshana oversteps.
Slants a full ball, around off, it lands and spins away. Warner is drawn forward to block it but gets beaten on the outside edge. Good amount of spin there.
Fuller and outside off, pushed to the left of mid off for a single. Finch is off the mark as well.
FOUR! David Warner is off the mark! The last ball just spoils a brilliant over from Chameera! A low full toss on middle. Warner lofts it high over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Who will bowl from the other end? It is Maheesh Theekshana.
A late no ball is called...

Beautiful delivery to end the over! On a length and slanting across. Warner stays back to defend but gets beaten on the outside edge. Ohh, wait, a no ball is called as Chameera overstepped. Free Hit coming up.
Short of a length and on leg. Warner hops and makes another block. Good start from Chameera. Tight from him.
On a length and just outside off. Warner gets on his toes and mistimes his block to the leg side.
Fuller ball, outside off. Warner drives it to the cover fielder where a good stop denies any run.
A full ball from wide of the crease and just outside off. Warner pushes it to covers and the man has a shy at the bowler's end as Finch was a touch out but he misses and even Finch comes back easily.
A full ball, nice and tight on middle. Warner prods and blocks it on the off side.
We are all set for the action. The players are out in the middle. Aaron Finch and David Warner are the openers for Australia. Dushmantha Chameera to start with the ball. Here we go...

Aaron Finch, the skipper of Australia says they expect it to turn after the shine goes off the ball and the wicket seems dry. Dasun Shanaka, the captain of Sri Lanka then says the seamers did not click as of now so they had a chat and they are hungry to do well. Mentions Lanka are happy to chase as they know the conditions. Finch they have three changes, Marsh, Green and Jhye Richardson come in. Shanaka then informs they have one change too, Dickwella comes in for Danushka Gunathilaka.

Pitch Report - Russel Arnold is pitchside. Arnold says it is very hot. Adds Colombo has more bounce but the pitch is quicker in Kandy. Adds the wicket is hard but it looks dry, it should be nice but it should be slower. Mentions it will be a challenging strip. Tells the skipper will win the toss and bat first!

Sri Lanka (Playing XI) - Niroshan Dickwella (In place of Danushka Gunathilaka), Pathum Nissanka, Charith Asalanka, Kusal Mendis (WK), Dhananjaya de Silva, Dasun Shanaka (C), Chamika Karunaratne, Dunith Wellalage, Dushmantha Chameera, Jeffrey Vandersay, Maheesh Theekshana.

Australia (Playing XI) - David Warner, Aaron Finch (C), Mitchell Marsh (In place of Steven Smith), Marnus Labuschagne, Alex Carey (WK), Travis Head, Glenn Maxwell, Cameron Green (In place of Pat Cummins), Jhye Richardson (In place of Mitchell Swepson), Matthew Kuhnemann, Josh Hazlewood.
TOSS - AUSTRALIA have won the toss and they will BAT first!

Australia have another worry in Steven Smith as he injured himself in the second match but there isn’t any call on him if he will be available or not. While other than that, we all know that the mighty Aussies are capable of and they will hope to bounce back again to winning ways. The big guns like David Warner, Marnus Labuschagne and Aaron Finch need to step up to restore the lead. Let’s hope we get a rain interrupted match. Toss and team news coming up shortly.
